role: Limited target-domain flower-region agreement diagnostic for the already frozen FCP ROI-v4 runtime. This is measurement validation only and cannot change any ecological decision.

fixed_denominator.zero_annotation_treatment: reference_unknown_empty: retain in the 110-image census, do not call flower-negative, and do not count a model mask as a verified biological false positive

reference_definition.supported_ontology: union of every COCO polygon component using category id 1 / generic label flowers for one exported image
reference_definition.claim_limit: generic flower-region reference only; not verified focal-taxon petal truth, anatomical completeness, or colour-valid petal mask
reference_definition.rasterization: deterministic polygon union in the exported JPEG coordinate frame using Pillow ImageDraw.polygon with floating COCO vertices converted to image coordinates by round-half-to-even through Python round(), then clipped to [0,width-1] and [0,height-1]; fill=1; no dilation, erosion, hole repair, topology repair or component filtering

orientation_and_alignment.decode: Pillow JPEG decode from the pinned ZIP member bytes
orientation_and_alignment.declared_dimension_gate: decoded stored JPEG width and height must exactly equal the corresponding COCO declared width and height
orientation_and_alignment.exif_gate: EXIF orientation must be absent or equal to 1; any other orientation makes the complete diagnostic not evaluable rather than transforming reference polygons after outcome
orientation_and_alignment.runtime_orientation: unchanged FCP ROI-v4 applies ImageOps.exif_transpose then RGB conversion; under the gate above this leaves the reference coordinate frame unchanged
orientation_and_alignment.failure_rule: any archive member mismatch, decode failure, declared-dimension mismatch, unsupported EXIF orientation, polygon rasterization failure, or missing COCO/image join makes the complete 110-image diagnostic not evaluable

frozen_fcp_runtime.mask_rule: use the unchanged original-orientation union flower_mask returned by FrozenFlowerColourEstimator.measure; no Monarda-specific threshold, component rule, morphology, colour prior or tuning
frozen_fcp_runtime.reason: the diagnostic evaluates localization itself; filtering to colour-admitted images would condition on downstream ROI/background/flip gates

per_image_scoring.runtime_failure_or_empty_prediction_on_p: retain image and assign intersection=0, predicted_pixels=0, precision=0, recall=0, IoU=0 and Dice=0
per_image_scoring.unknown_zero_annotation_image: report model/runtime status and predicted pixel count only; no precision/recall/IoU/Dice and no false-positive label

limited_gate.purpose: bounded operational adequacy of flower-region localization only
limited_gate.threshold_origin: reuse, without tuning to Monarda, the already frozen JRC locked-test floors: 0.70 mask containment/purity and 0.35 detector recall; apply them here only as conservative pixel-region precision and recall floors
limited_gate.pass_rule: all requirements must pass; no compensating composite score
limited_gate.failure_rule: report all rows and metrics, retain failure, do not retune or rerun a modified model on these same images

required: archive SHA and member SHA verification before decode
independent recomputation of every aggregate from saved per-image counts
synthetic polygon-rasterization tests including clipping and multiple-component union
synthetic model-failure and zero-annotation treatment tests

prohibited: threshold search or component filtering after scores are seen
using provider train/valid/test labels to choose parameters
relabeling the zero-annotation image as a verified negative
colour measurement or geographic/ecological inference from Monarda
publication of raw JPEGs or polygon vertices
reclassification of the reserve matched flower-minus-background p=0.087
PR merge or manuscript submission based on this diagnostic alone
claim_ceiling: A pass supports only bounded flower-region localization agreement of the unchanged FCP ROI-v4 runtime on this 110-image Monarda export under generic flowers polygon reference. It does not establish focal-petal accuracy, annotation completeness, calibrated colour, ecological replication, taxonomic generality, or causal biology.
